entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. My name is Amy. How can I help you today?
Yeah, hi. I need to return something. It's a VeloBand Pulse. I'm not happy with it.
Okay, I can help you with that. Could you please provide your order number or the email address associated with your purchase?
It's [Customer Email Address]. Look, I don't have time for this. I just want to return the darn thing. It’s been… I don’t know… a little over two weeks.

Thank you. I've located your order. I understand you'd like to return your VeloBand Pulse. No problem. Our standard return policy allows for returns within 90 days of purchase, as long as the item is in good condition.

90 days? Seriously? I thought I was stuck with this useless smart watch. Okay, well that's a relief. So, what do I need to do? I’m kind of mad I didn’t realize I had so much time, I wouldn’t have wasted my time trying to make it work.

I apologize for any confusion regarding our return policy. Let me go ahead and process a return for your VeloBand Pulse. I'll email you a prepaid shipping label that you can use to send it back to us. Once we receive the returned item, a full refund will be credited back to your original payment method. Can you confirm the shipping address is still [Shipping Address]?
Yes, that's correct. And how long will that take, the refund I mean?

Once we receive the VeloBand Pulse, please allow 7-10 business days for the refund to be processed. You'll receive an email notification once the refund has been issued. I can also note your account and escalate the refund request to my manager once the package is delivered, if you like?

Yes, please do that. I'd appreciate it. Just make sure it happens quickly. Honestly, the initial 10 days I spent trying to get the thing to work were frustrating. So escalating to your manager to get this done fast sounds perfect. Thanks!
Absolutely. I've added a note to your account and escalated the refund request. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, I think that's it. Thank you so much for your help!
You're very welcome! Have a great day, and thank you for choosing VeloFit.
